caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic candlestick rendered in tones of silver and subtle gold, with areas of reflected light creating slight hints of blue and brown. The candlestick is depicted upright, centered on a plain, light beige background. The object has a wide, round base with intricate ridged detailing near the edge, a tapered and fluted stem featuring two ornamental bands with similar ridging, and a cup-shaped holder at the top also bordered with decorative ridges. The surface reflects ambient light, giving a sense of gloss and metallic sheen. The illustration includes no other objects or background elements, and the artist's signature, "FRANK KEANE," appears in the lower left corner.
title: Silver Candlestick
